results.title: French Novelist Michel Houellebecq Indicted for Predicting Violent French Backlash to ‘the Great Replacement.’
results.description: A French judge on Tuesday placed Michel Houellebecq, one of Europe’s best-known living novelists, under formal investigation — mis en examen — for alleged complicity in incitement to discrimination, hatred, or violence, over a November 2022 Front populaire interview with the philosopher Michel Onfray.
